rv.q: Phillips' powerhouse, all-in cast provides its own magnitude.
The play and production land with heavyweight force when delivering a climactic coup de théâtre that manifests the psychic fight behind the physical one.
“The Royale” is a splendid tale with exceptional professionals at the top of their game.
This is profound theatre that will shake you up.

In Tyrone Phillips’ exceptional production, enhanced by superb technical support, including Gregory Graham’s period perfect costumes, and performed by an incredibly gifted cast, Writers Theatre continues their 35th Anniversary Season with a nail-biting Clash of the Titans.
This ensemble cast melds perfectly to create the world of 1900s boxing, with its violence, racial tension and the truth at the heart of the play.
It’s a spectacular blend of boxing and historical events that dramatizes the trials and tribulations of dreams realized and deferred.
The matches are throat clutching nail biters, even if you know the story of John Jackson’s stellar career.
It should be on you MUST SEE list for this season.

cn.t: Critics hail this riveting, emotionally charged production about boxer Jack Johnson as spellbinding, praising Marco Ramirez's compact script and the show's exploration of race and ambition in the Jim Crow era.
